subject: Quantify AI — pilot qualification & performance evidence
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Kaur <samir.kaur@quantify.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quantify AI — pilot qualification & perf evidence

Hi Samir — great demo earlier. Quick follow-up with a concise qualification and the evidence pack I promised. TL;DR: we think a small pilot (2–4 GPUs) can validate your retrieval + summarization flow; recommended model slate and perf expectations below. Attachments: prompt-pack-v2.md, quantify-eval-traces.zip, redwood-perf-summary.csv

What we recommend for the pilot (initial scope)
- Recommended models (balanced cost/quality):
  - redwood-2.1-opt-16k (fp16) — best latency/quality tradeoff for short-summary workloads
  - llama-2-70b-q4f16 — higher-quality option; expect higher p99 at scale
- Quantization profile: q4[f16] for the 70B to preserve generation quality in extraction tasks
- Autoscaling: target baseline 4 concurrent streams with burst to 12 during peak batch jobs

Quick performance snapshots (see full CSV attached):
- redwood-2.1-opt-16k @ 512 tokens, concurrency 4: median latency 78ms/token, p99 token-latency ~360ms, sustained ~120 TPS
- llama-2-70b-q4f16 @ 512 tokens, concurrency 4: median latency 190ms/token, p99 token-latency ~820ms, sustained ~48 TPS

Links & artifacts attached:
- redwood-perf-summary.csv — full microbenchmarks (latency percentiles, TPS by concurrency, token-length sweep)
- prompt-pack-v2.md — our starter prompt sets + regression test prompts we use for stability checks
- quantify-eval-traces.zip — representative traces from a retrieval+summarize workload (token counts, KV cache profiles)

Next steps (proposed):
1) Confirm pilot goals & SLA targets (throughput vs p99 tradeoff)
2) We share a short prompt/eval subset you can run locally (or we can run in-hosted pilot)
3) Kickoff call to finalize procurement and timeline — proposed Wed 7/13 10:00 PT (30 min)

Please let me know which items you want in the pilot scope and any specific compliance docs Procurement needs (SOC2, data retention window).

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: prompt-pack-v2.md (markdown, 32KB)]
[Attachment: quantify-eval-traces.zip (zip, 4.2MB)]
[Attachment: redwood-perf-summary.csv (csv, 210KB)]

From: Samir Kaur <samir.kaur@quantify.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-11T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quantify AI — pilot qualification & perf evidence

Thanks Hannah — really helpful summary. Two quick asks before we lock scope: 
1) Can you confirm the p99 latency at our target concurrency of 8 streams for the two recommended models at ~1k token targets? We care a lot about tail latency because our UI stitches multiple summaries in series.
2) Can you paste a 2–3 prompt excerpt (from prompt-pack-v2.md) so our devs can eyeball guardrails?

Also Procurement asked for: a) SOC2 evidence link, and b) a rough pricing footprint (monthly committed GPU hours) for a 4-week pilot that targets 50k generated tokens/day average. If you can give ranges that’d be great.

On schedule — Wed 7/13 10:00 PT works for us.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Kaur
Head of Product, Quantify AI

On Jul 11, 2028, at 09:12, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Samir — great demo earlier. Quick follow-up with a concise qualification and the evidence pack I promised...

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-11T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quantify AI — pilot qualification & perf evidence

Hannah / Aditya — notes to answer Samir's asks quickly (internal):
- p99 @ concurrency=8 (1k tokens) — pulled from redwood-perf-summary.csv (see attached slice). Rough numbers: 
  - redwood-2.1-opt-16k: p99 token-latency ~420ms -> estimated end-to-end p99 for 1k tokens ~420s (note: token-latency scales linearly; we include batching margins) ; effective TPS ~85 for sustained smaller batches
  - llama-2-70b-q4f16: p99 token-latency ~900ms -> estimated end-to-end p99 for 1k tokens ~900s ; effective TPS ~28
  (these are conservative; pilot-specific KV-cache locality and prefix caching often halves effective end-to-end latency for our retrieval flows)

- Prompt excerpt (paste from prompt-pack-v2.md):
  "System: You are an assistant that summarizes retrieved docs into concise bullets.
   User: Given the retrieved passages, produce a short summary (3-5 bullets) and include a one-line 'confidence' note. Avoid fabricating citations."

- Compliance/procurement quick answers:
  - SOC2: https://redwood.ai/compliance/soc2-2027 (shareable link; we can produce signed attestation)
  - Pricing footprint (estimates for Pilot 4 weeks, committed):
    - using 4x A100-equivalent GPUs with autoscaling to 8 for bursts: ~$45k–$70k (depends on reserved vs burst pricing + model choice)

I'll attach the CSV slice (redwood-perf-summary.csv) and a small excerpt to send to Samir. Suggest Hannah reply with the two-line procurement answers + attach prompt excerpt and the perf CSV slice.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Performance Engineering Lead | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-perf-summary.csv (csv, 21KB)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Kaur <samir.kaur@quantify.ai>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@quantify.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-12T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quantify AI — pilot qualification & perf evidence

Hi Samir / Priya — attaching the CSV slice and excerpted prompt pack as requested. Short answers in-line: 

1) p99 @ concurrency=8, ~1k tokens (conservative slices attached):
   - redwood-2.1-opt-16k: end-to-end p99 ~420s (per-token p99 ~420ms); expected sustained TPS ~80–90 depending on batch shapes
   - llama-2-70b-q4f16: end-to-end p99 ~900s (per-token p99 ~900ms); expected sustained TPS ~25–35
   Note: those end-to-end numbers are worst-case linear estimates. For your retrieval pattern we typically see 30–60% improvement because of prefix/KV cache reuse. We'll instrument the pilot to capture those traces so you have exact distributions.

2) Prompt excerpt (from prompt-pack-v2.md):
   "System: Summarize retrieved snippets into 3 concise bullets. Always include an explicit confidence score (low/medium/high). If source is uncertain, return 'uncertain' rather than inventing facts."

3) Compliance / procurement links and footprint:
   - SOC2 report (view): https://redwood.ai/compliance/soc2-2027
   - Pilot pricing estimate (4 weeks, 50k generated tokens/day): $45k–$70k depending on model and reserved hours (we can tighten after pilot scope discussion).

Attachments included: redwood-perf-summary.csv (slice), prompt-pack-v2.md (excerpt), quantify-eval-traces.zip (representative traces).

Next steps:
- Confirm pilot SLAs (throughput target vs acceptable p99) — we can lock scope in that 30-min call on Wed 7/13 10:00 PT.
- We'll provision a demo pilot environment and share a short onboarding checklist (data ingest, test prompts, evaluation hooks).

If you want, I can include a short Delta-runbook that shows how we compare observed tail latencies vs expected and when we trigger autoscale/fallback to smaller models.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
